Package control.db

Class DeductionBase

java.lang.Object
control.db.DeductionBase
public class DeductionBase extends Object
Front end for the storage of theorems and all their parts. Back end is sqlite www.sqlite.org.

A lot of functionality of the application has been chosen to rather reside in the base, as views, instead of rebuilding them at start-up and keeping collections in runtime objects. The currently used keyboard bindings are cached in that way for example.

      public DeductionBase(boolean passivemode)
      Instantiates a new data base front-end and back-end where the base file is located at 'data/sqlite/variables.sqlite'. The mini database is run by sqlite. www.sqlite.org.
      Parameters:
      passivemode - If this class should be run without the back-end database. For debugging purposes.
